data.name: Muthii
data.gender_notes: Muthii is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who follows the truth and righteous path. Derived from the Arabic root ‘mathana’, meaning to follow or comply. The name Muthii carries the meaning “Follower of Truth” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muthii usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of truth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Walking the truthful path towards God.
data.etymology: Muthii belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Follower of Truth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muthii total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: مُثِي
in_arabic.meaning: منسوب إلى المثي، يعني المثلي من حيث الخلق والطبع، أو منسوب إلى المثني، يعني المحافظ والمثبت
in_arabic.long_meaning: يُشير اسم المُثِي إلى صفة المثلي من حيث الخلق والطبع، وهو من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الجودة والكمال، ويُستخدم في تسمية الأطفال ليعبر عن آراء والديهما حول شخصيتهم، أو منسوب إلى المثني الذي يعني المحافظ والمثبت، وهو من صفات الله تعالى في التوراة، ويُستخدم لتعزيز صفات الأطفال مثل الثبات والمحافظة

in_urdu.name: مُثی
in_urdu.meaning: مسرت و خوشگو، خوش مزاج، خوش طبیعت
in_urdu.long_meaning: مُثی نام اسلمی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوش مزاج، خوش طبیعت، خوشگو، اس نام کا تعلق اسم میں سے ہے جس سے مراد خوش مزاج اور خوش طبیعت والا شخص ہے، اس نام کی اہمیت اس وجہ سے بھی ہے کہ اس سے انسان خوش مزاج اور خوش طبیعت والی دنیا میں خوشی اور سکون کا احساس کرتا ہے، اس نام کا استعمال والدین اپنے بچوں کے لیے کرتے ہیں تاکہ وہ خوش مزاج اور خوش طبیعت والے بن سکیں

in_pashto.name: مُثی
in_pashto.long_meaning: مُثی نوم داسلامي نوم دی چی ښه مزاجي ښه طبیعتی ښه خوشیو ښه ساکو دی، داسلامي دين او فرهنگ کي دا نوم ډیر ښه ګڼل کيږي، دا نوم داسلاميانو په کورني ژبه کي ډیر ښه ګڼل کيږي ځکه چی دا نوم داسلامي دين او فرهنگي اړخونو ته اشاره کوي، دا نوم داسلاميانو په کورني ژبه کي داسلامي دين او فرهنگي اړخونو ته اشاره کوي

in_english.long_meaning: The name Muthii is derived from the Arabic root 'm-th-y', which means 'to be benevolent, good-natured, pleasant, and agreeable'. In Islamic tradition, the name Muthii is associated with the qualities of kindness, generosity, and compassion. It is believed that individuals with this name are blessed with a gentle and benevolent nature, and are more likely to be successful in their endeavors. The name Muthii is also mentioned in some Quranic verses, where it is used to describe the qualities of the righteous and the virtuous.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun's Muqaddimah. The chapter on the Bedouin mentions the Muthil tribe, which is believed to be the origin of the name Muthii.
historical_references.context: Ibn Khaldun, a prominent Arab historian and sociologist, wrote an influential work called the Muqaddimah. In this work, he discusses the origins and characteristics of various civilizations, including the Bedouin tribes of the Arabian Peninsula. One of these tribes is the Muthil tribe, which is believed to be the origin of the name Muthii.

historical_references.reference: Al-Baladhuri's Ansab Al-Ashraf. The Muthil tribe is mentioned as one of the tribes that participated in the Battle of Hunayn, which took place in 630 CE.
historical_references.context: Al-Baladhuri, an early Islamic historian, wrote a comprehensive work called Ansab Al-Ashraf. In this work, he mentions the Muthil tribe as one of the tribes that participated in the Battle of Hunayn, which was a significant military engagement between the Muslim army of Muhammad and the Meccan army, resulting in the defeat of the latter.
